My specialties are that I provide the customer with full documentation so that they remain in control of their network and can be vendor agnostic (i.e. not locked into my services). Additionally, I am more than just IT, I also specialize in electronics and can consult with regards to PCBA, product design, and testing.  What will happen if your IT guy gets hit by a bus? Or if the cloud services suddenly go offline? Don't be caught dependent upon your IT vendor. Work with a company that provides full documentation so that you remain in control.   Don't fall into the hardware obsolescence trap. Deploy hardware that is built to last. My routers and servers do not necessarily need to be replaced every couple years. Less landfill waste. Better for the environment. I try to avoid upselling, and subscriptions when possible. Follow the golden rule.  Capabilities:  IT  * Windows, Debian, and Alpine Linux Servers. * Router/Firewall Setup and Management * Wifi Access Points * File backup and archives * Surveillance Systems * Digital Signage (Building Directories, Take-out Restaurants) * Accounting Software Setup (Quickbooks, Dolibarr, Sage 50) * Email Setup Assistance and archives * Basic user troubleshooting and daily tech assistance * VPNs    Electronics  * Tektronix TDS2012B Oscilloscope * Fluke 27, 77 Multimeter * IET LCR-500 Handheld Meter * Tenma 72-6607 3GHz Handheld Counter * P2K Weller Butane Portable Soldering Iron * Circuit Specialists CSI1501 0-15 1A Power Supply * Multicomp Pro MP710254 Power Supply * Stainless Steel Metric Digital Calipers (Unbranded) * General Plastic Imperial Dial Calipers Made in Switzerland * Starret 25-142 0.001" Precision Dial Indicator to 0.050" * 0.001" Precision Dial Indicator to 1" (Unbranded) * Velleman HPS10 Portable Oscilloscope * Prusa i3 MK3 3D Printer * Leister CH-5065 Kagiswil Hot Air Tool * Yihua 948 Desoldering Station * TwoTrees CNC 3018 for Prototype PCBs (Able to get traces down to about 20mil, but this is a WIP) * NTE Semiconductors, Optoelectronics, & Related Products Book 15th Edition * Assortment of components, wire, enclosures, and various other materials   Specialties:  Full Documentation of your Network: You retain all network information. Historical backup of files, so that you can restore files from the past (not just a running backup like Google Drive or Onedrive). I specialize in Linux Servers, which are becoming more popular than WIndows. For example, Amazon, Google, Android, and Github are all based on Linux and Open source software (Free and Open software).   Built to last: I deploy hardware that does not require replacement every couple years. Linux servers can be updated year after year, and do not require a reinstallation/hardware replacement, unlike Microsoft Server OS. My Routers, also can be updated, and never go End of Life. The one exception to this is WiFi, which unfortunately, requires somewhat proprietary options at this point. There is no good option for WiFi that is built to last. However, my surveillance systems are guaranteed, as well as the digital signage.  Surveillance systems: I have built up to 40 camera systems. Mobile phone access. Future proof: No vendor lock-in. No cloud dependency. Email alerts. Further accessories, such as motion detectors, signs, and sensors can be added. I have built weatherproof portable systems, that can be connected to via cellphone internet, and can be brought to record for short term (e.g. weeks or months) on job sites. I can do object detection, and potentially facial recognition/custom object detection.  Electronics Design & Repair:  I have experience with microcontrollers, some FPGA programming, PCB layout, some assembly, some mechanical design, and above all, a competent base in electronics design. Repairing items is done more for fun, rather than for profit, but I am available, if someone has something they would like possibly fixed.  Mechanical Design: 3D printing with FreeCAD and a Prusa i3 MK3. I have a printables profile, where you can view some of my work. We are in the golden age of 3D printers, and there's really no reason not to be proficient with some mechanical design.  Programming: Python, C, HTML/PHP/CSS, Lisp. Arduino. custom business solutions. I have read more than a few O'Reilly books (and many others). I am looking for an opportunity to do business database software.  I'm located 10 miles north of Boston. For more details see steakelectronics dot com. $42/hr or more at the customer's discretion.

Full Title: Organic SEO Expert
Description: Post   If your website is nowhere to be found in Google search results, or trailing behind competitors on page 1, 2 or beyond, I can help.  I specialize in organic SEO and have re-optimized hundreds of thousands of web pages for clients nationwide on the heels of inexperienced individuals unable to pinpoint or resolve what ailed their websites.  By "organic", it means I achieve top rankings naturally (by skill) and not by paid ads, so your website's pages are shown to search users over competitors.  I am a Google guru with an advanced SEO skill set and proven track record of achieving results (I have wonderful client reviews).    My experience includes SaaS (software as a service), e-commerce (B2B, B2C and D2C), medical marketing, cosmetic dentistry, plastic surgery, legal, manufacturing, construction, career testing, digital publishing, home and commercial services, real estate, and more.   Every business owner wants their site at the top of Google search results, but that goal is often elusive (most websites with poor Google rankings suffer from similar problems).   Increasing conversions -- the purchase of a product, subscription or request for service -- is the #1 key to increasing revenue. When I re-optimize your site, you will see:  top organic rankings for your keywords; increased click-throughs from search results; increased conversions; calls to action that actually get action; faster page loads and A-grade performance scores; and revenue growth you have dreamed about.  I will manage your website's SEO and work with your developer(s) or mine on whatever needs to be resolved programming-wise. Once I know which SEO skeletons are in which closet, I can determine what needs attention and where, and in what order.  Effective search engine optimization and digital marketing are tedious. Achieving top Google rankings on small sites with hundreds of pages or less typically takes 4-6 months (yes, really). Enterprise sites with thousands or hundreds of thousands of pages typically see results in 7-10 months.  Competitors gain revenue, brand recognition and reviews with every click that goes to them and not your business. Therefore, the best time to start was yesterday.   Google cautions business owners to be wary of "black hat" (unethical) guarantees to bring your site to the top of search results within days or weeks. Rankings are algorithmic, so those strategies will lead you and your site down the wrong path, if they haven't done so already.   The same is true for “SEO Band-aids” -- cheap and quick fixes that do not resolve underlying performance and usability problems affecting rankings. Then months later, business owners realize they were misled and the status quo remained unchanged.   Along with frequent and transparent reporting, I routinely:  assess what caused a rankings penalty; resolve technical issues that slow down page speed; manage Google Business Profile for local search (if applicable); review competitor websites and conduct keyword and market research; compose/re-write narrative content (text), meta data, heading tags, and internal/XML sitemaps; resolve technical issues, write redirects and resolve crawl errors; and manage site re-design (if applicable), etc.  I also offer site audits (audits are informational so you know where the problems lie, but are not a re-optimization).    I have worked on many platforms and custom-built sites using the latest technologies but specialize in WordPress. I am cPanel, robots.txt, .htaccess, FTP, WP Admin, Wordfence Security, and HTML-proficient, read CSS and JavaScript, and re-design/re-structure websites to make them visitor and search engine friendly and ensure pages load fast.  If you have been disappointed by mediocre SEO results that failed to grow your revenue, I look forward to hearing from you. To receive my bio and client reviews, kindly respond with your name and URL of the site needing optimization and tell me a little bit about your needs.  My process is to briefly review your website before I reply to your inquiry, so I can have an intelligent conversation about my observations. I will discuss fees during our initial phone call.

Full Title: Organic SEO Expert
Description: Post   If your website is nowhere to be found in Google search results, or trailing behind competitors on page 1, 2 or beyond, I can help.  I specialize in organic SEO and have re-optimized hundreds of thousands of web pages for clients nationwide on the heels of inexperienced individuals unable to pinpoint or resolve what ailed their websites.  By "organic", it means I achieve top rankings naturally (by skill) and not by paid ads, so your website's pages are shown to search users over competitors.  I am a Google guru with an advanced SEO skill set and proven track record of achieving results (I have wonderful client reviews).    My experience includes SaaS (software as a service), e-commerce (B2B, B2C and D2C), medical marketing, cosmetic dentistry, plastic surgery, legal, manufacturing, construction, career testing, digital publishing, home and commercial services, real estate, and more.   Every business owner wants their site at the top of Google search results, but that goal is often elusive (most websites with poor Google rankings suffer from similar problems).   Increasing conversions -- the purchase of a product, subscription or request for service -- is the #1 key to increasing revenue. When I re-optimize your site, you will see:  top organic rankings for your keywords; increased click-throughs from search results; increased conversions; calls to action that actually get action; faster page loads and A-grade performance scores; and revenue growth you have dreamed about.  I will manage your website's SEO and work with your developer(s) or mine on whatever needs to be resolved programming-wise. Once I know which SEO skeletons are in which closet, I can determine what needs attention and where, and in what order.  Effective search engine optimization and digital marketing are tedious. Achieving top Google rankings on small sites with hundreds of pages or less typically takes 4-6 months (yes, really). Enterprise sites with thousands or hundreds of thousands of pages typically see results in 7-10 months.  Competitors gain revenue, brand recognition and reviews with every click that goes to them and not your business. Therefore, the best time to start was yesterday.   Google cautions business owners to be wary of "black hat" (unethical) guarantees to bring your site to the top of search results within days or weeks. Full Title: Organic SEO Expert
Description: Post   If your website is nowhere to be found in Google search results, or trailing behind competitors on page 1, 2 or beyond, I can help.  I specialize in organic SEO and have re-optimized hundreds of thousands of web pages for clients nationwide on the heels of inexperienced individuals unable to pinpoint or resolve what ailed their websites.  By "organic", it means I achieve top rankings naturally (by skill) and not by paid ads, so your website's pages are shown to search users over competitors.  I am a Google guru with an advanced SEO skill set and proven track record of achieving results (I have wonderful client reviews).    My experience includes SaaS (software as a service), e-commerce (B2B, B2C and D2C), medical marketing, cosmetic dentistry, plastic surgery, legal, manufacturing, construction, career testing, digital publishing, home and commercial services, real estate, and more.   Every business owner wants their site at the top of Google search results, but that goal is often elusive (most websites with poor Google rankings suffer from similar problems).   Increasing conversions -- the purchase of a product, subscription or request for service -- is the #1 key to increasing revenue. When I re-optimize your site, you will see:  top organic rankings for your keywords; increased click-throughs from search results; increased conversions; calls to action that actually get action; faster page loads and A-grade performance scores; and revenue growth you have dreamed about.  I will manage your website's SEO and work with your developer(s) or mine on whatever needs to be resolved programming-wise. Once I know which SEO skeletons are in which closet, I can determine what needs attention and where, and in what order.  Effective search engine optimization and digital marketing are tedious. Achieving top Google rankings on small sites with hundreds of pages or less typically takes 4-6 months (yes, really). Enterprise sites with thousands or hundreds of thousands of pages typically see results in 7-10 months.  Competitors gain revenue, brand recognition and reviews with every click that goes to them and not your business. Therefore, the best time to start was yesterday.   Google cautions business owners to be wary of "black hat" (unethical) guarantees to bring your site to the top of search results within days or weeks. Rankings are algorithmic, so those strategies will lead you and your site down the wrong path, if they haven't done so already.   The same is true for “SEO Band-aids” -- cheap and quick fixes that do not resolve underlying performance and usability problems affecting rankings. Then months later, business owners realize they were misled and the status quo remained unchanged.   Along with frequent and transparent reporting, I routinely:  assess what caused a rankings penalty; resolve technical issues that slow down page speed; manage Google Business Profile for local search (if applicable); review competitor websites and conduct keyword and market research; compose/re-write narrative content (text), meta data, heading tags, and internal/XML sitemaps; resolve technical issues, write redirects and resolve crawl errors; and manage site re-design (if applicable), etc.  I also offer site audits (audits are informational so you know where the problems lie, but are not a re-optimization).    I have worked on many platforms and custom-built sites using the latest technologies but specialize in WordPress. I am cPanel, robots.txt, .htaccess, FTP, WP Admin, Wordfence Security, and HTML-proficient, read CSS and JavaScript, and re-design/re-structure websites to make them visitor and search engine friendly and ensure pages load fast.  If you have been disappointed by mediocre SEO results that failed to grow your revenue, I look forward to hearing from you. To receive my bio and client reviews, kindly respond with your name and URL of the site needing optimization and tell me a little bit about your needs.  My process is to briefly review your website before I reply to your inquiry, so I can have an intelligent conversation about my observations. I will discuss fees when we speak.

Full Title: Organic SEO Expert
Description: Post   If your website is nowhere to be found in Google search results, or trailing behind competitors on page 1, 2 or beyond, I can help.  I specialize in organic SEO and have re-optimized hundreds of thousands of web pages for clients nationwide on the heels of inexperienced individuals unable to pinpoint or resolve what ailed their websites.  By "organic", it means I achieve top rankings naturally (by skill) and not by paid ads, so your website's pages are shown to search users over competitors.  I am a Google guru with an advanced SEO skill set and proven track record of achieving results (I have wonderful client reviews).    My experience includes SaaS (software as a service), e-commerce (B2B, B2C and D2C), medical marketing, cosmetic dentistry, plastic surgery, legal, manufacturing, construction, career testing, digital publishing, home and commercial services, real estate, and more.   Every business owner wants their site at the top of Google search results, but that goal is often elusive (most websites with poor Google rankings suffer from similar problems).   Increasing conversions -- the purchase of a product, subscription or request for service -- is the #1 key to increasing revenue. When I re-optimize your site, you will see:  top organic rankings for your keywords; increased click-throughs from search results; increased conversions; calls to action that actually get action; faster page loads and A-grade performance scores; and revenue growth you have dreamed about.  I will manage your website's SEO and lead your developer(s) or mine on whatever needs to be resolved programming-wise. Once I know which SEO skeletons are in which closet, I can determine what needs attention and where, and in what order.  Effective search engine optimization and digital marketing are tedious. Achieving top Google rankings on small sites with hundreds of pages or less typically takes 4-6 months (yes, really). Enterprise sites with thousands or hundreds of thousands of pages typically see results in 7-10 months.  Competitors gain revenue, brand recognition and reviews with every click that goes to them and not your business. Therefore, the best time to start was yesterday.   Google cautions business owners to be wary of "black hat" (unethical) guarantees to bring your site to the top of search results within days or weeks. Rankings are algorithmic, so those strategies will lead you and your site down the wrong path, if they haven't done so already.   The same is true for “SEO Band-aids” -- cheap and quick fixes that do not resolve underlying performance and usability problems affecting rankings. Then months later, business owners realize they were misled and the status quo remained unchanged.   Along with frequent and transparent reporting, I routinely:  assess what caused a rankings penalty; resolve technical issues that slow down page speed; manage Google Business Profile for local search (if applicable); review competitor websites and conduct keyword and market research; compose/re-write narrative content (text), meta data, heading tags, and internal/XML sitemaps; resolve technical issues, write redirects and resolve crawl errors; and manage site re-design (if applicable), etc.  I also offer site audits (audits are informational so you know where the problems lie, but are not a re-optimization).    I have worked on many platforms and custom-built sites using the latest technologies but specialize in WordPress. I am cPanel, robots.txt, .htaccess, FTP, WP Admin, Wordfence Security, and HTML-proficient, read CSS and JavaScript, and re-design/re-structure websites to make them visitor and search engine friendly and ensure pages load fast.  If you have been disappointed by mediocre SEO results that failed to grow your revenue, I look forward to hearing from you. To receive my bio and client reviews, kindly respond with your name and URL of the site needing optimization and tell me a little bit about your needs.  My process is to briefly review your website before I reply to your inquiry, so I can have an intelligent conversation about my observations. I will discuss fees when we speak.
